friction: Builder plan_add_dv accepted a bogus DV name ('xxx_probe'); only validate_plan rejected it, and without suggestions or the allowed-name list.
No builder tool for constraints or the optimizer; had to switch to write_plan YAML, using the omd://plan-schema resource for field names.
operating_points with 'ac|...' keys (structural_fudge, propeller diameter, engine rating) were accepted but silently had no effect (diameter stayed 2.28, engine 750 hp).
aircraft_data nested overrides alongside aircraft_template were accepted but silently ignored.
run_plan 'overrides' must be plan-level keys (e.g. initial_values), not variable paths; the first attempt failed with a schema error.
initial_values silently ignores unknown variable names; 'ac|weights|structural_fudge' did nothing and the working path was 'climb.OEW.structural_fudge', found by probing get_results.
Analysis run_plan responses are very large (full per-node profiles) even at recording_level=minimal.

get_results summary=true and multi-variable vector queries exceed the client output limit and cannot be filtered to the final case, so final climb.throttle and component_sizing_margin values could not be read back.
run_plan in optimize mode hit the client's 60 s MCP timeout; the run finished server-side and I found its run_id through get_provenance.
mixed_objective and constraint names were not listed in the docs; I used OpenConcept HybridTwin example names, which validate_plan accepted.
